sn3.12:3.2: “Here, sir, while we five kings, supplied and provided with the five kinds of sensual stimulation, were amusing ourselves, this discussion came up among us:
sn3.12:5.2: When you’re happy with certain sounds, as you’ve got all you wished for, you don’t want any other sound that’s better or finer.
sn3.12:6.2: When you’re happy with certain smells, as you’ve got all you wished for, you don’t want any other smell that’s better or finer.
sn3.12:7.2: When you’re happy with certain tastes, as you’ve got all you wished for, you don’t want any other taste that’s better or finer.
